principles.singleSourceOfTruth: Macaly/Convex remains the canonical operational content and protected-data layer.
principles.publicSafety: Only sanitized, explicitly approved public records may flow into GitHub or public presentation surfaces.
principles.avoidDuplication: New tools must serve a distinct operational role and must not become a competing content database.

platforms.role: Canonical operational content, protected data, and backend services
Version control, sanitized public distribution, schemas, manifests, and deployment automation
Production and preview deployment for interactive frontend surfaces
Backend services, workers, integration bridges, and failover where Vercel or GitHub Pages is unsuitable
Public presentation surface consuming approved content
Interactive public presentation and prototype surface
Keyword strategy, technical visibility, competitor analysis, and search-performance auditing
Runtime errors, latency, availability, backend failures, API health, and deployment regressions
Privacy-conscious funnels, navigation, CTA, estimator, form, scheduling, resource, and course engagement analytics
Cross-brand design tokens, reusable components, responsive patterns, and governed visual specifications
Optional downstream lead, consultation, inquiry, and follow-up management
Optional structured applications, intake packets, signatures, and advanced workflows

eventFlow: Visitor interacts with a presentation surface
Approved analytics events flow to Amplitude without protected form content
Operational logs and service health flow to Datadog
Lead data flows to HubSpot only when CRM automation is activated and consent requirements are satisfied
Canonical content changes originate in Macaly/Convex
Sanitized public snapshots and schemas are versioned in GitHub
Vercel, Railway, Google Sites, ChatGPT Sites, and SharePoint consume only their approved distribution tier
